description: Sales tax rates by jurisdiction where CBC has nexus. Every other US state and Canada is untaxed - a state absent from this table resolves to a 0% rate, not an error. See .claude/memory/sales_tax_rules.md.
note: Apply from the ship-to / project location, not the GC billing address. If the project state is unknown, leave tax UNRESOLVED and flag it - never default to zero silently.
